ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:12 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly low-intensity black surface (#000000). High-intensity white clusters (#FFFFFF) located at the distal tips of both lobes. Multiple high-contrast linear white markings: two horizontal parallel lines on the lower left lobe; long, intersecting curved lines across the upper right lobe; several shorter diagonal lines on the outer left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge shows high-frequency serration. Left lobe features a distinct deep indentation midway between the notch and the tip. Right lobe shows increasing serration amplitude and frequency towards the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge displays a continuous concave sweep from the central notch towards both distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity white pixels at the extreme left and right tips, appearing as irregular circular aggregations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions. Specifically: a pair of parallel horizontal lines on the mid-left lobe; multiple long, overlapping arcs on the right lobe; and several diagonal lines on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake-mark patterns visible as white linear features across both lobes. A prominent irregular notch is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe indicating significant tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cross-hatched pattern of white scars on the right lobe, creating a distinct visual texture compared to the relatively sparser left lobe.
